description: GET ONLY the 'Look' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel. Look - the look of the app's interface laid over the project's src/ui.config.ts at start, no rebuild: Theme (UI kit colour tokens -> #rrggbb: bgTop, bgBottom, panel, panelDeep, panelEdge, ink, nav, text, textDim, gold, goldDeep, green, greenDeep, blue, blueDeep, red, redDeep, purple, purpleDeep, orange, orangeDeep, teal, tealDeep; derived tones are computed), Radius and ButtonRadius (px 0..64), Outline (px 0..8), Background (a screen pattern id: gear (the default game-gear pattern), plain, dots, stripes, grid, hex, stars, waves, checker, confetti, bubbles, zigzag, diamonds, clouds, leaves, circuit, sparkles, rays, bricks, paws, snow), MotionSpeed (0.1..5, 1 default), MotionIntensity (0..3, 1 default), Particles, SoundSet (classic, soft, retro, magic, sci-fi, wood). Every field optional; unset keeps the project's own value.
